purpose: Teach: 長期間/しまわ/すんなり/売り切れ/兆し/区切り/近日/工具

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今の体制、長期間、続けるのは、難しいわね。
lines.en: Keeping the current system going long-term is going to be difficult.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact opening, mild concern underneath. Steady pace. Thoughtful pause before 'difficult'—she's already turned this over in her mind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料、ちゃんとしまわないと、紛失リスク、あります。
lines.en: Right. We'll need to make sure the documents are properly stored, or we risk losing them.
lines.style: Attentive, following her lead. Slight lean-in on 'properly stored'—he's already thinking through the steps. Measured, responsible tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: クライアント、すんなり、契約に応じてくれたよ。
lines.en: The client came on board without any trouble, though.
lines.style: Lighter, a small shift upward. Pride in the win, understated. Quick delivery on the good news—doesn't linger over it, but lets it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。人気商品、また売り切れ、追加発注しました。
lines.en: Right. The popular item sold out again, so we've already placed a reorder.
lines.style: Steady report, slight undertone of approval. The efficiency matters to him. Even pace—no surprise here, just confirmation of what they expected.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市場、改善の兆し、見えてきたね。
lines.en: We're starting to see signs that the market's turning around.
lines.style: Quieter observation, almost to herself. Careful not to overstate it. Soft, hopeful exhale. She's learning to trust the trend.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトの区切り、報告会、設定済みです。
lines.en: Right. We've already scheduled the project checkpoint and the report meeting.
lines.style: Confirmation, practical. He's ahead of the curve—this was handled. Clean delivery, no fanfare. The competence shows in the brevity.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 人事評価の発表、近日、予定だよ。
lines.en: The HR evaluations should be announced soon, by the way.
lines.style: Brief heads-up, neutral delivery. No judgment attached. She's passing information, not making predictions. Matter-of-fact but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。修繕の工具、まとめて発注いたしました。
lines.en: Right. I've placed a bulk order for the repair tools.
lines.style: Final confirmation, task closed. Small note of finality—the last loose end tied. Polite formality, but warm. The conversation finds its natural end.
